title: Double Diamond design process
description: Explore the problem before committing to an approach and test alternatives before delivery.

rules.instruction: Explore the problem with the people affected, then narrow it to a design question tied to observed behavior. Keep consequential unknowns visible.
rules.verification: Review a sample of research evidence with the team and check that it supports the chosen design question.

rules.instruction: Explore alternatives before investing in a detailed solution. Test promising prototypes on the same user task so differences can inform selection.
rules.verification: Record what users could complete, where they struggled and which evidence led the team to keep, refine or discard each alternative.
